table.leaveBody: Your seat will be taken by a bot.

callbreak.redealNoSpade: Redeal a hand with no spade
callbreak.redealNoFace: Also redeal a hand with no J, Q, K or A
callbreak.mustTrump: Must trump even if you cannot beat
callbreak.mustTrumpHint: When off, you may play any card if you cannot beat the spade already on the table.
callbreak.bonus8: A made bid of 8 or more scores 13
cb.illegal: You have to follow the rules of the trick. Try a highlighted card.
cb.noLastTrick: No trick has been played yet.
cb.rules.goal: Four players, spades are always trump. Each round you say how many tricks you will win, then try to win at least that many.
cb.rules.bid: Starting after the dealer, everyone bids once, from 1 up to the highest bid. Nobody passes.
cb.rules.play1: Follow the suit that was led. If you can beat the best card of that suit on the table, you must.
cb.rules.play2: If you have none of that suit, you must play a spade, and beat any spade already played if you can.
cb.rules.win: The highest spade wins the trick. With no spade, the highest card of the led suit wins. The winner leads next.
cb.rules.score: Make your bid and you score the bid, plus 0.1 for each extra trick. Miss it and you lose the bid. After the last round the highest total wins.
pass.title: Pass to {name}
pass.body: Hand the device over. Nobody else should look until you tap.
setup.mode: How do you want to play?
setup.onlineSoon: Online rooms arrive in a later build.
setup.needPerson: At least one person has to play.

room.relayOff: Relay is available if people cannot connect.

rangi.challengeHint: The next player may challenge. If it was a bluff the player draws 4, otherwise the challenger draws 6.
rangi.callEkHint: Forget and another player can call "Caught!" before the next turn: you draw 2.
rangi.stackingHint: Draw Two on Draw Two, Draw Four on Draw Four. Whoever cannot stack takes the whole pile.
rangi.stackMixed: Let Draw Two and Draw Four stack on each other
rangi.sevenZeroHint: A 7 swaps hands with a player you choose. A 0 passes every hand along.
rangi.jumpInHint: Play an identical card out of turn.
rangi.illegal: That card doesn't fit. Try a highlighted one, or draw.
rangi.stackOrTake: Stack a draw card or take {n}
rangi.challengeBody: {name} played a Wild Draw Four. Challenge it, or take the cards.
rangi.rules.goal: Be first to play every card. Match the card on the pile by color, number or symbol.
rangi.rules.play: Play a card that matches the color, number or symbol of the top card, or a Wild. If you cannot, draw one card and play it if it fits.
rangi.rules.skip: Skip: the next player loses their turn.
rangi.rules.reverse: Reverse: play changes direction. With two players it works like Skip.
rangi.rules.draw2: Draw Two: the next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
rangi.rules.wild4: Wild Draw Four: pick a color; the next player draws four and loses their turn. You should only play it when you hold no card of the current color. The next player can challenge it.
rangi.rules.ek: When you are down to one card, tap Ek! before the next player acts. If someone taps Caught! first, you draw two.
rangi.rules.score: The winner scores the cards left in every other hand: numbers count their value, Skip, Reverse and Draw Two are 20, Wilds are 50. First to the target score wins.
lb.bankerRotateHint: Number of rounds before the banker passes on. 0 keeps the same banker.
lb.loseOnZero: Lose the stake when the symbol does not show
lb.illegal: That bet isn't allowed right now.
lb.noChips: You don't have enough chips for that.
lb.maxReached: The most you can put on one symbol is {n}.
lb.rules.goal: Six dice, six symbols. One player is the banker. Everyone else bets chips on the symbols they think will show.
lb.rules.bet: Pick a chip, then tap a symbol on the mat to put it there. You can bet on several symbols. Lock your bets when you are done. The banker can close betting early.
lb.rules.roll: The banker shakes the covered bowl and lifts the lid. Count the dice showing each symbol you bet on.
lb.rules.pay: If your symbol does not show, you lose your stake. If it shows once you win your stake again, twice you win double, and so on up to six times. The banker pays and collects. The table can change every payout in the rules.
jp.dealCountHint: With many players the deal is cut down so at least 10 cards stay in the stock.
jp.pairColor: A pair must be the same color too
jp.stake: Chips each player pays the winner
jp.illegal: That move isn't allowed right now.
jp.draw: Draw from the stock or take the top discard
jp.rules.goal: Make every card in your hand part of a pair. Jokers pair with anything.
jp.rules.turn: Draw from the stock or take the top discard. If your whole hand is now pairs, declare and win. Otherwise throw one card away.
jp.rules.joker: The indicator card is turned up under the stock. Every card one rank above it, in any suit, is a joker (King wraps to Ace). A joker pairs with any card, and two jokers pair together. The table can use the same rank instead.
jp.rules.score: Win a round to score a point. First to the target number of rounds takes the match.
dh.fixedRoundsHint: 0 plays until one player is left. Otherwise the lowest total wins.
dh.eliminateAtHint: Exactly on the number is still in.
dh.jhyapLimit: Call Jhyap with a total of
dh.noFirst: No Jhyap in the first round of turns
dh.penaltyHint: Added when someone has the same total or lower.
dh.jokersWild: Jokers can fill a set or a run
dh.pickAny: Pick any card from a run
dh.throwAfter: Throw a matching card at once
dh.throwAfterHint: If the stock card has the rank you just threw, you may throw it too.
dh.noFirstHint: Jhyap isn't allowed in the first round of turns.
dh.rules.goal: Keep your hand total low, then call Jhyap when you think it is the lowest at the table.
dh.rules.turn: Either call Jhyap, or throw cards and then pick one.
dh.rules.throws: You can throw one card, two to four cards of the same rank, or a run of three or more in one suit. Ace is low only.
dh.rules.pick: Then pick the top of the stock, or one card from the last throw. From a run you can only take an end card.
dh.rules.jhyap: At the start of your turn, with a total within the limit, call Jhyap. Everyone shows their hand. If you are strictly lowest you score 0 and everyone else adds their total.
dh.rules.counter: If anyone has the same total or lower, you add your total plus a penalty and the lowest of the others scores 0.
dh.rules.game: Card values: Ace 1, 2 to 10 as shown, Jack 11, Queen 12, King 13. A player whose score goes over the limit is out. The last player in wins.
tp.maxBlindHint: After this many blind bets a player has to look at their cards.
tp.potLimitHint: When the pot reaches this the remaining players are shown at once.
tp.tie.asker: The player who asked for the show loses
tp.autoChaal: A timeout bets instead of packing
tp.autoChaalHint: When the turn timer runs out the player bets the usual amount.
tp.illegal: That move isn't allowed right now.
tp.sideWait: Waiting for {name} to answer a side show
tp.yourTurnSeen: Your turn: bet, raise or pack
tp.yourTurnBlind: Your turn: look, or bet blind
tp.sideBody: {name} wants to compare hands. If you accept, the lower hand packs.
tp.rules.goal: Three cards each. Bet, raise or pack until one hand is left or two players show.
tp.rules.seq: A-K-Q is the highest sequence, A-2-3 the second highest. K-A-2 is not a sequence. Suits never break ties.
tp.rules.bet: Everyone puts in the boot. You start blind: a blind bet is the stake, a seen bet is double. Raising doubles the stake. Look at your cards whenever you like; after that you pay double.
tp.rules.side: Side show: a seen player can ask the previous seen player to compare hands. If they accept, the lower hand packs. A tie packs the asker.
tp.rules.show: When two players are left either can pay for a show. Hands are compared and the winner takes the pot.
kt.salamiHint: Winning all three shows: every other player pays one extra boot.
kt.tie.earlier: The earlier player in turn order wins it
kt.descending: Groups must go strongest to weakest
kt.descendingHint: Show 1 at least as strong as Show 2, and so on.
kt.top235Hint: The lowest hand becomes the highest.
kt.kitti: Kitti! Nobody won two shows. The pot carries over.
kt.arrangeNow: Arrange your nine cards into three groups
kt.rules.goal: Nine cards each. Split them into three groups of three and win at least two of the three shows.
kt.rules.arrange: Everyone arranges at the same time. Tap a card, then a slot to place it. Auto arrange picks a strong split for you.
kt.rules.show: Show 1 is compared across all players, then Show 2, then Show 3. The best group wins that show.
kt.rules.win: Win two shows and you take the pot. Win all three for a salami bonus. If nobody wins two, it is a Kitti and the pot carries to the next hand.
kt.rules.rank: Groups rank like Teen Patti hands: trail, pure sequence, sequence, color, pair, high card.
ib.aceHighHint: When off, an Ace as the first post can be high or low.
ib.aceChoice: The first post is an Ace: high or low?
ib.guess: The posts are equal: higher or lower?
ib.yourBet: Bet that the next card lands between, or pass
ib.rules.goal: Two cards stand as posts. Bet that the next card falls strictly between them.
ib.rules.turn: Two cards are dealt face up. If they are equal or next to each other there is no gap and you pass for free. Otherwise bet from the minimum up to the pot or your chips, or pass.
ib.rules.pay: Between the posts: you win your bet from the pot. Outside: your bet goes into the pot. Equal to a post: you pay double.
ib.rules.ace: An Ace as the first post can be high or low unless the table plays Ace high. When the pot is empty everyone antes again.
mg.mode.kidnap: Kidnap: their maal goes to the winner
mg.bonusSeen: Winner bonus from a seen player
mg.bonusUnseen: Winner bonus from an unseen player
mg.supermanHint: Wild before and after seeing, and allowed in pure sequences.
mg.jokerDublee: Two printed jokers make a dublee
mg.draw: Draw from the stock, or take the discard
mg.mustShow: You took the discard: show your sets now
mg.discardOrShow: Select cards to show, or discard one
mg.rules.goal: Twenty-one cards each. Make every card part of a set, show your sets, and declare to win.
mg.rules.turn: Draw from the stock or take the top discard (when allowed), optionally show, then throw one card away.
mg.rules.pure: A pure sequence is three or more cards in a row of one suit with no wilds. A-2-3 and Q-K-A work, K-A-2 does not. A tunnela is three identical cards.
mg.rules.trial: After you have seen: a trial is three of a rank in different suits, and a sequence may use wilds.
mg.rules.see: Show three pure sets (or seven dublees, pairs of identical cards) and you get to see the hidden joker card. Until then you may only take the discard if it completes a pure set you show on that turn.
mg.rules.maal: Tiplu is the joker card itself, poplu the next rank up in its suit, jhiplu the next rank down, alter the same rank in the other suit of the same color. The same rank in the other color is an ordinary joker. After seeing, all of them are wild. Jhiplu, tiplu and poplu together make a marriage.
mg.rules.dublee: Show seven dublees. After that you may only take a discard that makes your eighth, and you win when you hold eight.
mg.rules.score: Each player with maal scores their points times the number of players, minus the total of everyone, so the round always adds up to zero. The winner also collects 3 from each player who has seen and 10 from each who has not.
